rules.title: Security Deposit Limits, Interest, and Return Requirements
rules.requirement: Landlords must hold security deposits in a separate interest-bearing bank account in Massachusetts, provide a receipt and annual interest statement, cannot charge more than one month's rent as a security deposit, cannot demand rent in advance beyond the current month plus security deposit, and must return the deposit within 30 days after tenancy ends.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent maximum; interest at passbook savings rate or 5%
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential tenancies in Massachusetts where a security deposit is collected.
rules.penalty: Failure to comply with deposit-in-separate-account/receipt requirement entitles tenant to immediate return of the security deposit; tenant may deduct unpaid interest from next rent payment.
rules.quoted_span: No lessor or successor in interest shall at any time subsequent to the commencement of a tenancy demand rent in advance in excess of the current month's rent or a security deposit in excess of the amount allowed by this section.

rules.title: Security Deposit Account and Interest Requirements
rules.requirement: Landlords must keep tenant security deposits in a separate interest-bearing bank account located in Massachusetts, give the tenant a receipt within 30 days, and pay accrued interest annually or upon termination of tenancy.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential tenancies in Massachusetts where a security deposit is collected.
rules.penalty: Failure to maintain the required record or provide the receipt entitles the tenant to immediate return of the security deposit plus accrued interest.
rules.quoted_span: Any security deposit received by such lessor shall be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank, located within the commonwealth under such terms as will place such deposit beyond the claim of creditors of the lessor, including a foreclosing mortgagee or trustee in bankruptcy, and as will provide for its transfer to a subsequent owner of said property.
